Leg 6's headline -- 'the mirror is precisely the operation the object cannot perform on itself, which is WHY the observer's bit is exactly one, and external' -- rests on both B1203's climb and the mirror map sharing the same kappa-invariance identity (kappa o g - kappa = 0 in Z[x,y,z]); this is a shared-invariant coincidence elevated to an explanatory claim ('this is why') without an independent argument that invariance-preservation is the correct criterion for what counts as 'internal'.

The arc's headline number ('89% absent') is the banked snapshot at authoring time. The committed verification/_out.txt and verification/claim_base.json (evidently re-run at a later point against a since-grown corpus) show materially different figures (80% absent, ratio 2.67x vs 2.29x) without any note in the arc reconciling the discrepancy, and reproduce.sh's pass/fail check (grep VERIFIED) does not detect that the reproduced numbers diverge from the banked ones. A stranger reproducing this arc today gets different numbers than the ones quoted in FINDINGS.md/arc_verdict.json.
census/control/ratio numbers are read directly from the arc's own results.json with no independent recomputation in the test
